==English==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|vntil}}, {{m|enm|until}}, {{m|enm|untill}}, {{m|enm|ontil}}, {{m|enm|ontill}}, perhaps representing a northern variant of {{cog|enm|unto}} (see Modern English {{m|en|unto}}). {{surf|+pre|en|un|t1=against; toward; up to|id1=until|till|id2=inh-en-enm-til}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{enPR|ŭn-tĭlʹ|ən-tĭlʹ|a=UK,CA}} {{IPA|en|/ʌnˈtɪl/|/ənˈtɪl/|/ʊnˈtɪl/|}}
* {{enPR|ŭn-tĭlʹ|ən-tĭlʹ|a=US}} {{IPA|en|/ʌnˈtɪl/|/ənˈtɪl/}}
** {{IPA|en|/ɪnˈtɪl/|a=nonstandard}}
* {{enPR|ŭn-tĭlʹ|a=Appalachians,also}} {{IPA|en|/ˈʌntəl/}}<ref>{{R:Hall PGSMS|2|I.5|59}}</ref>
* {{audio|en|En-us-until.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɪl|s=2}}
* {{hyphenation|en|un|til}}

===Preposition===
{{en-head|prep}}

# Up to the time of (something happening); pending.
#: {{ux|en|If you can wait '''until''' after my meeting with her, we'll talk then.}}
# Up to (a certain place)
#: {{ux|en|Keep walking '''until''' the second set of traffic lights, then turn left.}}
# Before (a time).
#* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=1|passage=I was about to say that I had known the Celebrity from the time he wore kilts. But I see I will have to amend that, because he was not a celebrity then, nor, indeed, did he achieve fame '''until''' some time after I left New York for the West.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} To; physically towards.
#* {{RQ:Spenser Faerie Queene|book=I|canto=XI|stanza=4|passage=He rousd himselfe full blith, and hastned them '''untill'''.}}
# <!--not sure what part of speech to consider this-->{{lb|en|without an object}}<!--{{lb|en|US}}?--> Up to the time that the foods or other things available to sell, or tasks which need to be completed, [[run out]].<!-- [[Wiktionary:Tea room/2023/April#until]] -->
#: ''Bake sale on Saturday, 2pm '''until'''.''
#*: A celebration of his life will also be held at Pete's Tavern 16705 Florida Blvd on Saturday, March 3, 2018 from 2pm '''until''' and at TJ's Lounge 11585 Plank Road on Sunday, March 4, 2018 from 2pm '''until'''. He is survived by his children, {{...}} 
#*: Open Monday to Saturday 4pm – '''Until''' and Sunday 12pm - '''Until'''. We are conveniently located at: {{...}}

===Conjunction===
{{en-head|conj}}

# Up to the time that (a condition becomes true).
#: {{ux|en|Not '''until''' I got his email did I fully understand his disappointment.}}
#: {{ux|en|It took us a week before/'''until''' we got the house repainted.}}
#* {{RQ:Weyman Chippinge Borough|I|01|passage=It was April 22, 1831, and a young man was walking down Whitehall in the direction of Parliament Street.{{nb...}}. He halted opposite the Privy Gardens, and, with his face turned skywards, listened '''until''' the sound of the Tower guns smote again on the ear and dispelled his doubts.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-07-19|author=w:Peter Wilby
|volume=189|issue=6|page=30|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly
|title=[http://www.theguardian.com/education/2013/jul/01/education-michael-gove-finland-gcse Finland spreads word on schools]
|passage=Imagine a country where children do nothing but play '''until''' they start compulsory schooling at age seven. Then, without exception, they attend comprehensives until the age of 16. Charging school fees is illegal, and so is sorting pupils into ability groups by streaming or setting.}}
# [[before|Before]] (a condition becoming true).
#* {{RQ:Birmingham Gossamer|chapter=I|passage=It is never possible to settle down to the ordinary routine of life at sea '''until''' the screw begins to revolve. There is an hour or two, after the passengers have embarked, which is disquieting and fussy.}}
